confirmedFindings.title: Distributed Lock TTL Expiration Without Heartbeat Extension
confirmedFindings.body: The 1000ms distributed lock TTL expires if slowProvisionTrunkResources takes longer than 1 second, allowing another cluster node to acquire the lock and allocate the same trunk channels simultaneously.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Implement a background heartbeat timer to renew the distributed lock TTL until the operation completes or use monotonic fencing tokens.
